main_text.p: stupidum & stolidum significare ac intelligere soleant:idq; propterea credo, quod nemo illis, nisi stupidus & stolidus, ad Chimæras papales credendas aptus & idoneus videatur.

Hæc mihi fere in mentem veniebant, quæ tuo excitatus, & nescio quomodo illuminatus sermone, dicenda putarem de Societate Iesu, deq; suis, quæ ipsa præcipuè colit & veneratur, idolis. Tum Paulus fortibus me oculis intuens, Non quæram, inquit, posthac amplius tantæ cæcitatis Iesuiticæ causas, excusationes non recipiam: si in te potuit tantum veritatis lumen institutione Iesuitica deprauari, ac propemodum, nisi ipse, credo, huc diuinitus venissem, extingui; quid ego in obscuris & tenebricosis aliorum animis non fieri existimem? Quæ cum dixisset, finitæ signum nostræ recreationis dabatur, & vterq; nostrum com-presso, ut fit, sermone, in suum se cubiculum recepit.

page.notes: Ornaments (fleurons) above and below the text omitted as non-text. Doubtful readings: "soleant" (printed with a long s, read as "foleant" by the scan); "recreationis" joined across the line break without a visible hyphen; "com-presso" hyphen at line end as printed. Printed "Iesuitica" and "Iesuiticæ" kept as printed.
